g.text: Electrical ports and numerical state integrators from nanowireElectrothermal_NbN_v5c
Their node voltages represent temperature rise or resistance. They are not physical capacitors on the detector.
1 V represents 1 K at NdTe4 and NdTph4; 1 V represents 1 Ω at NRdom4. The sources inject each state's time derivative.
The 1 GΩ references produce negligible temperature-state relaxation. The domain diode provides a smooth lower clamp.
Algebraic B-source calculations are grouped on the following page; their reference resistors and diagnostic outputs are omitted here.
